trials.claim: Plan 3 includes 1 additional seat for teams for 2 seats total

trials.claimQuote: 2 additional seats for teams (3 seats total)
trials.reasoning: No exhibits were admitted for this claim, so there is no evidence to confirm or contradict the seat count.

trials.claim: WizWrite transforms spoken words into polished text using advanced AI
trials.claimQuote: WizWrite is a voice productivity tool that transforms spoken words into polished text using advanced AI.
trials.reasoning: Buyers report speech was not recorded, transcribed completely incorrectly, or important recordings were lost, directly undercutting reliable transformation into polished text despite the defense examples.

exhibits.quote: A large portion of the speech is either not recorded at all or transcribed completely incorrectly.
exhibits.argument: This directly contradicts the claim that spoken words are transformed into polished text.

exhibits.quote: So I lost a few very important recordings which were over 10 minutes long.
exhibits.argument: Losing important recordings undermines the promise of reliable transformation of speech to text.

exhibits.quote: Just Speak. Get a polished email, to-do list, or summary instantly.
exhibits.argument: The vendor states speaking produces polished output instantly, supporting transformation of spoken words into polished text.

exhibits.quote: This also makes a big difference compared to a normal transcription, because the text is restructured and provided with punctuation and paragraphs by the AI.
exhibits.argument: The buyer confirms AI restructures speech into punctuated paragraphs, supporting polished text via advanced AI.

trials.claim: WizWrite offers on-device transcription, system-wide hotkeys and integrations
trials.claimQuote: It offers on-device transcription for privacy, system-wide hotkeys for quick access, and integrates with various applications to streamline workflows.
trials.reasoning: The vendor lists system-wide hotkeys and on-device AI, plus webhook integration across tools; the extension login complaint does not contradict that these features are offered.

exhibits.quote: The Chrome extension is randomly not logged in per tab, depending on what websites I currently visit.
exhibits.argument: A randomly logged-out extension undermines the claim of integrations that streamline workflows.

exhibits.quote: Native app with system-wide hotkeys, menu bar access, and on-device AI.
exhibits.argument: The vendor lists system-wide hotkeys and on-device AI for the Mac app, supporting hotkeys and on-device transcription.

exhibits.quote: Your voice becomes work across the tools you already use — connected through webhook integration.
exhibits.argument: The vendor states voice work connects across tools via webhook integration, supporting integrations claim.

trials.claim: WizWrite is available on Mac, iPhone, iPad and web
trials.claimQuote: WizWrite is available on Mac, iPhone, iPad, and the web, providing a seamless experience across devices.
trials.reasoning: A buyer reports the tool does not work in the browser as told, directly conflicting with the claimed web availability, even though Mac and mobile availability are supported.

exhibits.quote: They tell that the tool would work in browser, but this is not the case.
exhibits.argument: Failure in the browser contradicts the claim of availability on the web.

exhibits.quote: Native app with system-wide hotkeys, menu bar access, and on-device AI.
exhibits.argument: The vendor describes a native Mac app, supporting availability on Mac.

exhibits.quote: Private offline transcription in your pocket with on-device AI.
exhibits.argument: The vendor describes offline transcription in your pocket for iPhone and iPad, supporting availability on those devices.

trials.claim: Wiz Write marketing tagline promises voice interaction with AI unlocks superpowers
trials.claimQuote: Speaking gives your thoughts clarity; using your voice to interact with AI unlocks superpowers
trials.reasoning: The 'superpowers' tagline is subjective puffery, and the reviews conflict anecdotally between gibberish output and reported clarity and major time savings, so it cannot be verified either way.

exhibits.quote: there are times I need to jump into ChatGpt 4 for the final draft.
exhibits.argument: Needing another AI for the final draft undermines the promise that voice interaction unlocks superpowers.

exhibits.quote: everything is lumped together into an endless stream of gibberish.
exhibits.argument: Producing gibberish contradicts the promise of clarity and superpowers from voice interaction.

exhibits.quote: This application understands my languages (Fren-Glish) and intentions better over time, helping me express written ideas with a clarity I could not achieve alone.
exhibits.argument: The buyer confirms the app gives clarity to thoughts and ideas, supporting the clarity part of the tagline.

exhibits.quote: Tasks that used to take me hours now get done in minutes!
exhibits.argument: The buyer reports dramatic time savings creating content, supporting the unlocks superpowers promise.
